results.title: Sociological Fidelity in Healthcare Simulation – ICE Blog
results.content: Published Time: 2022-11-29T07:00:00+00:00 Sociological Fidelity in Healthcare Simulation – ICE Blog The ICE blog promotes discussion among Clinician Educators from around the world, archiving a variety of education resources. * A Day in the Life by drvictoriabrazilNovember 29, 2022 2:00 am December 1, 2022 Sociological Fidelity in Healthcare Simulation Discussions about the ‘fidelity’ of simulation often focus on the physical realism of mannikins or other training equipment. Maybe simulation activities can be designed to recreate some of the most important influences on healthcare team performance – issues of power, hierarchy, and professional boundaries – and achieve ‘sociological fidelity’? Without attention to these relational issues and cultural norms, we may fail to transfer lessons from simulation-based team training to real world practice. write that “_despite the interprofessional tensions and wider sociological factors present in clinical work – we have noted that such issues are not currently represented in conventional simulation scenarios_”, but lament that “_Operationalizing (these) concepts which are complex and nuanced will be challenging_”. Simulation delivered in real clinical environments, with real clinical teams, may naturally embrace power dynamics, hierarchies and conflicts from the real world. But they are also exemplars for how we might operationalise sociological fidelity in simulation practice. The success of these study teams opens the door to considering other important issues through simulation e.g. exploring power dynamics between healthcare consumers and providers, exploring cultural differences, and (carefully) considering issues of equity, diversity and inclusion. Perhaps at the very least we need to pay attention to the sociological phenomena we routinely observe in simulation, and ensure we are not perpetuating problematic power dynamics and hierarchies. results.title: Top Graphic Design Trends to Watch in 2026 - Datum Creative Media
results.content: # Top Graphic Design Trends to Watch in 2026. As the design world continues to evolve, staying ahead of the curve is more important than ever. For brands, agencies, and in-house marketing teams, understanding the latest graphic design trends can be the key to creating visual content that captivates, converts, and cuts through the noise. At Datum, we work closely with clients across commercial and education sectors to deliver brand-defining creative that doesn’t just follow trends—but helps set them. Here are the top graphic design trends we believe will shape 2026:. Why it matters: In an era of information overload, neo-minimalism helps brands build trust through clarity and sophistication. Designers are now blending human creativity with machine precision to generate textures, patterns, and layouts that feel both futuristic and organic. Watch for: Generative AI tools being used to develop concept visuals, background elements, and adaptive branding systems. Designers are using colour blocking to guide the eye, create drama, and highlight CTAs, especially across digital platforms. Whether it’s animated logos, scrolling effects on websites, or subtle micro-interactions, motion design is becoming a brand essential. Real impact: Motion design increases engagement and improves UX, particularly in social and digital ad content. This includes tactile textures, overlapping elements, and a blend of 2D and 3D graphics for added visual intrigue. Design idea: Combine photography with digital collage or illustrated overlays to create a hybrid, multi-sensory look. Typography isn’t just a design element; it’s a brand statement. Retro-futurism blends 70s and 80s aesthetics (metallics, grids, lo-fi effects) with modern design sensibilities, creating visuals that feel familiar yet forward-looking. ###### Why This Matters for You. Graphic design trends aren’t just for creatives to admire. Whether you’re refreshing your website, launching a campaign, or overhauling your brand identity, aligning with current design thinking ensures your message feels fresh, relevant, and resonant. Our design team combines strategic insight with creative flair to help commercial and education clients alike stay visually ahead of the game. From brand identity and logo design to campaign visuals, social media templates, and event graphics, we offer full creative support – as a one-off or on a retained basis.
